evidence: A rank ensemble of the seed-averaged GraphSAGE and the HPO+STRING histogram model improves both macro and micro AUPRC over either component.
observation: A rank ensemble of the seed-averaged GraphSAGE and the HPO+STRING histogram gave 0.948859 macro/0.952483 micro, and a 70/30 GNN/histogram mix gave 0.949354/0.955772. Components were GNN 0.935867/0.938604 and histogram 0.944786/0.943522; recorded as F-0017.
subject: F-24
title: GNN plus external histogram rank ensemble beats both components
